accounting.invariant: 1.15*(committed + open cell reservations + TORN escrows + SHADOW + requested + overhead) <= 4500 at every frozen admission
accounting.retry_rule: infrastructure tears retry at most twice per cell (frozen protocol); the 3rd tear HALTS
accounting.science_failure: worker-reported / malformed / unclassified release HALTS the campaign; never retried (frozen protocol)
accounting.settlement: charge = max(0, U_final - C_run); all run-owned reservations closed; committed[role] += charge (exact measured run CPU)
accounting.torn_release: frozen release() moves the reservation to an OPS:TORN escrow (never dropped, never zero)

locks.campaign: kernel flock on <runtime_dir>/campaign.lock for the whole run + owner identity (host, boot id, pid, start time, run id, unit, invocation id)
locks.frozen_ledger_lock: DEAD if written before current boot / owner pid dead / pid reused (started after the lock); LIVE if a sanctioned producer; else AMBIGUOUS; only DEAD is reclaimed, only under the campaign lock

runtime_state.installed_into: <git common dir>/info/exclude (verified byte-identical and by probes before every run)
runtime_state.vultr: no git gate; every file under production/ is content-classified; unexpected files refuse

service.logs: <runtime_dir>/logs/<run_id>.log (child) + systemd journal (supervisor); never inside a source tree
service.manager: systemd transient SYSTEM service created with systemd-run (one unit per run)
service.restart_policy_why: Restart=no: every (re)start must pass the deterministic pre-start recovery by an explicit operator start; a crash loop can never burn budget unattended

stop_conditions.wall_clock_14_days: NOT ENFORCED: the parent production authorization excludes wall-clock bindings; flagged OPEN_GOVERNANCE (inventory R09)

what_this_is: ADDITIVE PRE-RESULT OPERATIONAL successor. It binds the parent production authorization unchanged and adds only the execution, recovery and accounting-settlement contract of the lifecycle. No science, threshold, scope, shard, topology, order, provenance or handoff semantics is changed.
